description: This file contains internal utility classes and functions for managing execution order and ordering validation in PyTorch's Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) module, specifically related to handling parameter handles, execution order tracking, and prefetching logic during distributed training.

classes.name: _ExecOrderWarnStatus
classes.description: Enum used internally to track the warning status of execution order validation.

classes.name: _ExecOrderData
classes.description: Class responsible for tracking and validating the execution order of FSDP handles during distributed training, including pre-forward and post-forward ordering, and managing prefetch limits.

methods.name: None __init__( self, debug_level: dist.DebugLevel, backward_prefetch_limit: int, forward_prefetch_limit: int, )
methods.description: Constructor initializing the execution order data structure with debug level and prefetch limits.

methods.name: None init( self, state: _FSDPState, root_module: nn.Module, process_group: dist.ProcessGroup, )
methods.description: Initializes internal data structures with information from the root module and process group for execution order validation.

methods.name: bool is_first_iter(self)
methods.description: Property returning whether the current iteration is the first for execution order validation.

methods.name: FlatParamHandle|None get_handle_to_backward_prefetch( self, current_handle: FlatParamHandle, )
methods.description: Returns the handle to prefetch for backward pass given the current handle.

methods.name: FlatParamHandle|None get_handle_to_forward_prefetch( self, current_handle: FlatParamHandle, )
methods.description: Returns the handle to prefetch for forward pass given the current handle.

methods.name: None record_post_forward(self, handle: FlatParamHandle | None)
methods.description: Records a handle in the post-forward order list.

methods.name: None record_pre_forward( self, handle: FlatParamHandle | None, is_training: bool )
methods.description: Records a handle in the pre-forward order list and checks execution order during the first iteration.

methods.name: None _check_order(self, handle: FlatParamHandle, is_training: bool)
methods.description: Checks execution order consistency across ranks during the first iteration, issuing warnings or errors as needed.

methods.name: tuple[int|None,...] _get_handle_indices( self, handle: FlatParamHandle, )
methods.description: Returns indices of handles in the all_handles list.

methods.name: list[list[str]] _get_names_from_handle_indices( self, handle_indices: tuple[int, ...], )
methods.description: Retrieves fully qualified names for handles based on their indices.

methods.name: list[list[str]] _get_names_from_handles( self, handle: FlatParamHandle, )
methods.description: Retrieves fully qualified names for a handle.

methods.name: next_iter(self)
methods.description: Prepares the data structures for the next iteration, including clearing post-forward order and updating iteration count.

ctags.name: WARNED
ctags.pattern: /^    WARNED = auto()  # deviated in a previous iteration$/

ctags.name: WARNING
ctags.pattern: /^    WARNING = auto()  # deviated this iteration; currently issuing warnings$/

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, debug_level: dist.DebugLevel, backward_prefetch_limit: int, forward_prefetch_limit: int, )

ctags.name: _check_order
ctags.pattern: /^    def _check_order(self, handle: FlatParamHandle, is_training: bool) -> None:$/

ctags.name: init
ctags.signature: ( self, state: _FSDPState, root_module: nn.Module, process_group: dist.ProcessGroup, )

ctags.name: record_post_forward
ctags.pattern: /^    def record_post_forward(self, handle: FlatParamHandle | None) -> None:$/

ctags.name: record_pre_forward
ctags.signature: ( self, handle: FlatParamHandle | None, is_training: bool )

fields.name: WARNED = auto()  # deviated in a previous iteration
WARNING = auto()  # deviated this iteration; currently issuing warnings
